package.description: A programmer's utility for inspecting and modifying window properties

en-GB.description: A programmer's utility for inspecting and modifying window properties
en-GB.longDescription: WinSpy++ is a native Win32 developer utility for inspecting windows, controls, styles, properties and related information in running Windows applications. It also provides a window-finder tool for selecting windows directly from the desktop.
en-GB.name: WinSpy
